entries.note: The fixture writes actual ANSI/Unicode rows through a PTY; native wheel/key events must expose older rendered cells and return to executed input. Direct fixture input m only stimulates asynchronous output while the GUI reads history. Alternate-screen output must not enter primary history. Resize and move the terminal, focus a second real shell, then hover-scroll the first while keyboard input still executes in the second. GUI restart rebuilds history from the same retained process. Optional local ended-Codex byte replay verifies scrolling actual CLI redraw output without starting a coding agent. All fixture processes are isolated and cleaned up; recordings and screenshots remain ignored local evidence.
